title: A Wreck for the Compass
author: Vesper Fairweather
blurb: Dominic Delacroix, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
